title: 第5章 秦兰姐-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “臭小子，你还知道给我打电话？”

    秦兰穿着一件卡其色大衣，下半身搭配一件淡蓝色牛仔裤，她没好气地瞪了魏沐一眼，精致的眉头微微蹙起：“你说说你，都多久没跟家里联系了？”

    “叔叔阿姨很担心你知道吗？”

    她和魏沐都来自SY市沈河区，两家是故交。

    魏沐来考艺术院校，就是受了这位干姐姐的影响。

    “嘿嘿，姐，我这不是忙吗。”

    魏沐挺着一张笑脸，弯下腰蹲在秦兰面前，用手轻轻摇晃她的胳膊。

    在原主的印象里，他从小就跟着这位干姐姐屁股后头玩。

    两人感情不错。

    不过秦兰毕竟比他大好几岁，一直把自己当成弟弟。

    本来一直好好相处，结果两个月前，这小子不知道抽什么风，不跟家里联系，也不接她电话。

    要不是打电话到他学校，知道这小子学籍还在，她都以为对方被开除了。

    魏沐还能说啥呢，只能不断点头道歉。

    原主脑子也属于拎不清的。

    被香港的制片人一顿忽悠，愣是瞒着家里人不说，孤零零的来到港岛拍戏。

    这不是大傻子，是啥？

    有这么好的资源不利用，居然想着靠自己？

    走后门在这圈子里都不叫事儿！！

    其实大家痛恨的不是走后门，而是走后门的不是自己。

    有姐姐这条又香又美的大腿，不应该紧紧抱住嘛。

    秦兰到底心软，看他这副样子，叹了口气，语气缓和了些：“行了，你先起来，地上凉...”

    别看魏沐现在是一米八的大小伙子，但是在她眼里，一直是跟在自己身后的调皮蛋。

    魏沐笑着坐在她身边，殷勤的给其倒了一杯茶。

    “说说吧，你这段时间在干什么？”

    秦兰接过喝了一口茶，眉眼弯弯的看着对方。

    于是，魏沐把被骗经过全部讲了出来。

    没嫌丢人，反正小时候光屁股的样子都被对方看过。

    这有什么丢人的？

    不过，他还是错估了秦兰的反应。

    这女人捏着茶杯，直到手指慢慢发白。

    沉默，长久的沉默。

    生气了，而且是非常生气的那种。

    “砰”的一声。

    秦兰重重的把茶杯放在桌上，洒出的茶水溅到她的大衣上。

    “你真是蠢啊！！香港这么远的地方，不打一声招呼就去了，幸好只是拍电影，要是被人贩子弄跑了，我怎么跟你爸妈交代？！”
    第(1/3)页

"You brat, you still know how to call me?"

Qin Lan was wearing a khaki coat and light blue jeans on her lower body. She glared at Wei Mu angrily and frowned slightly: "Tell me about you, how long have you not contacted your family?"

"Uncle and aunt are very worried, you know?"

She and Wei Mu are both from Shenhe District, SY City, and the two families are old friends.

Wei Mu came to art school because of the influence of this god-sister.

"Hey, sister, I'm busy right now."

Wei Mu put on a smiling face, bent down in front of Qin Lan, and gently shook her arm with his hand.

In the original owner’s impression, he had been playing with his god-sister since he was a child.

The two of them have a good relationship.

But after all, Qin Lan is several years older than him and has always regarded him as his younger brother.

We had always been getting along well with her, but two months ago, this guy was having trouble for some reason. He stopped contacting her family and refused to answer her phone calls.

If she hadn’t called his school and found out that the boy’s enrollment was still there, she would have thought that he had been expelled.

What else could Wei Mu say, he could only keep nodding and apologizing.

The original owner’s mind was also unclear.

Being fooled by a Hong Kong producer, I came to Hong Kong Island to film alone without telling my family.

This is not a big fool, what is it?

There are such good resources and you don’t use them, and you actually think about relying on yourself?

"It's not a big deal in this world to go through the back door!"!

In fact, what everyone hates is not the back door, but the person who used the back door is not themselves.

有姐姐这条又香又美的大腿，不应该紧紧抱住嘛。

Qin Lan was soft-hearted after all. Seeing his appearance, he sighed and softened his tone: "Okay, you get up first, the ground is cold..."

Although Wei Mu is now 1.8 meters tall, in her eyes, he has always been a naughty guy following her.

Wei Mu smiled and sat next to her, and poured her a cup of tea diligently.

"Tell me, what are you doing during this time?"

Qin Lan took a sip of tea and looked at him with crooked eyes.

So, Wei Mu told the whole story of being deceived.

“It’s not embarrassing, anyway, my naked buttocks were seen by each other when I was a child.

What’s so shameful about this?

However, he still misjudged Qin Lan’s reaction.

The woman squeezed the tea cup until her fingers slowly turned white.

Silence, long silence.

I am angry, and very angry.

"Bang" sound.

Qin Lan placed the tea cup heavily on the table, and the spilled tea splashed on her coat.

"You are so stupid! You went to a place so far away from Hong Kong without saying hello. Fortunately, you were just filming a movie. If you were run away by human traffickers, how would I explain it to your parents?!"
